extension.description: Inspect, filter, sort, chart and export collections while debugging. A database-grade collection and DataTable viewer for C#, F#, JavaScript and TypeScript.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Debugging and reading collections requires a local debug session.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Exploring collections evaluates expressions in the debuggee and writes exported files, so it is limited in untrusted workspaces.

view.explorer.welcome:
No collections yet.

Start a debug session, stop at a breakpoint, then right-click a collection variable in the **Run and Debug** view and choose **Explore Collection**.

[Pick a collection to explore](command:exploringCollections.pickAndExplore)

You can also press `Ctrl+Alt+E` (macOS: `Cmd+Alt+E`) while debugging.
configuration.title: Exploring Collections
configuration.maxRows.description: Maximum number of elements fetched from a collection. Set it to at least the collection size to see every row; larger values create more debugger traffic.
configuration.pageSize.description: Default number of rows shown per page in the collection view.
configuration.maxDepth.description: How many nested container levels are flattened into columns. Deeper levels stay expandable in the value pane.
configuration.fetchConcurrency.descripti: Number of concurrent `variables` requests sent to the debug adapter.
configuration.timeoutMs.description: Timeout of a single debug adapter request in milliseconds.
configuration.enableFilterPushdown.descr: Push filters down into the debugger as native expressions so that elements outside the fetched window can match.
configuration.enableCharts.description: Enable the chart view with the nine chart types.
configuration.showInlineHints.descriptio: Show a one line hint next to the stopped statement listing the collections of the current frame.
configuration.showCodeLens.description: Show an `Explore collection` CodeLens above every collection that is in scope at the current breakpoint.
configuration.showDesignTimePreview.desc: Show a **Preview data** CodeLens above collection literals in the editor, so data that is hardcoded in the source can be inspected without starting a debug session.
configuration.showHoverLinks.description: Add an `Explore collection` link to the tooltip of collection variables in the stopped file.
configuration.dateFormat.description: How date and time values are rendered in the grid.
configuration.columnOrder.description: Initial column order. Columns can always be rearranged by dragging their headers.
configuration.defaultExportFormat.descri: Format preselected when exporting a collection.
configuration.exportDirectory.descriptio: Default directory for exported files. Empty means the first workspace folder.
configuration.openExportedFile.descripti: Open the exported file after a successful export.
configuration.dictionariesAsRows.descrip: Render dictionaries and maps as one row per entry instead of one row per object member.
configuration.customDebugTypes.descripti: Map a debug type to a language provider, for example `{ "my-debugger": "csharp" }`.
configuration.excludedMembers.descriptio: Member names that are never turned into columns (debugger synthesized members such as `Count` or `Capacity`).
configuration.captureBudgetMs.descriptio: How long the JavaScript/TypeScript variables walk may spend reading a collection (the adapter needs one request per element there). What was read by then is shown and marked as truncated. The fast paths (adapter previews, helper file) are not limited by this budget.
